P. (कुचति, कुचित) 
__1 To utter a shrill cry (as a bird). 
__2 To go. 
__3 To polish. 
__4 To contract, bend. 
__5 To be contracted. 
__6 To stop, impede. 
__7 To write or delineate. 
__8 To mix, connect. --

P. कुञ्च् also (कोचति, कुञ्चति कुञ्चित) 
__1 To make crooked, bend or curve. 
__2 To move or go crookedly. 
__3 To make small, lessen. 
__4 To shrink, contract. 
__5 To go to or towards.
[कुच्--क] The female breast, a teat, nipple; अपि वनान्तरमल्पकुचान्तरा [[

.]] 
-Comp. 
-अग्रम्, -मुखम् a nipple. 
-कुम्भः the female breast. 
-तटम्, -तटी the slope of the female breast, the breast, (तट being स्वार्थे or meaningless). 
-फलः the pomegranate tree.
The female breast, especially that of a young or unmarried woman; see कुच.

a. (-रा, -री f.) 
__1 Going slowly, creeping. 
__2 Detracting, censorious. 
-रः A fixed star.

कूचिका,
कूची 
__1 A small brush of hair, a pencil. 
__2 A key.
A species of lotus (white water lily).
